name: Kurasawa Ayana
source:
Likes: Muffins
Dislikes: Mushrooms

A bright and cheerful girl with a personality that is incapable of overlooking those in need.
Sociable, deals with anyone without discrimination. Has high communicative skills and cheerfulness where she opens her heart with people on their first meeting. 
Works in the public morals committee at the school. Every morning with her lovely face, she energetically greets students passing through the school gate.
Due to her humane nature and actions, her popularity among students and teachers is very high. So to speak, she has an idol like existence within the school.
Also, she possesses emotional strength where she doesn't get discouraged by any kind of adversity. Her heart is strong to the point that once she decides on an objective, she will absolutely achieve it.
